title: kbingest.which() finds no mapper tool on Windows with Python 3.11, whose shutil.which ignores PATHEXT for a name with a folder
goal: kbingest.which(tool, path) finds TOOL.EXE, .CMD and the other PATHEXT forms in each PATH folder on Windows whatever the Python version: before 3.12, shutil.which(os.path.join(folder, tool)) checks only that exact name (docs.python.org shutil.which, Changed in 3.12), so on the supported floor 3.11 every mapper (dotnet, npm, cargo) was reported missing; POSIX unchanged; a Windows test gives shutil.which 3.11's behaviour and still finds a .CMD tool, and fails with the fallback removed. From the SP-hlfwfcx6 review (BG-a2a74kyb's which()).
